
# Gene Expression Signatures for the Accurate Diagnosis of Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma Entities in the Routine Clinical Practice
```{r}
pacman::p_load(httpgd,
    GEOquery,
    limma,
    umap,
    DT,
    tidyverse)

# Retrieving dataset
gset <- getGEO("GSE225759", 
    GSEMatrix =TRUE, 
    getGPL=FALSE)

# Check if there are multiple platforms
length(gset)

if (length(gset) > 1) idx <- grep("GPL33154", attr(gset, "names")) else idx <- 1
gset <- gset[[idx]]

colnames(pData(gset))
unique(pData(gset)$characteristics_ch1.5)
tail(pData(gset))

# Metadata
metadata = pData(gset) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        caseID="case # from supplemental table9 (pmid35839444):ch1",
        nanostring="nanosstringclass:ch1",
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
        geo_accession,
        characteristics_ch1.5,
        supplementary_file,
        nanostring,
        caseID
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
        subtype="characteristics_ch1.5") |>
    mutate(
        subtype=str_remove(subtype, "nanostringclass: "),
        subtype=str_replace_na(subtype, ""),
        nanostring=str_replace_na(nanostring, ""),
        final_subtype=stringr::str_c(subtype, nanostring)
        ) |>
    select(geo_accession,
    supplementary_file,
    caseID,
    final_subtype)

unique(metadata$final_subtype)

datatable(metadata)
atl_ptcl = metadata |>
    filter(final_subtype%in%c("ATLL", "PTCL-TBX21", "PTCL-GATA3", "ENKTL", "AITL", "ALCL-pos", "ALCL-neg")
    ) |>
    pull(geo_accession)

atl_ptcl = metadata |>
    filter(final_subtype%in%c("ATLL", "PTCL-TBX21", "PTCL-GATA3", "ENKTL", "AITL", "ALCL-pos", "ALCL-neg"))|>
    select(geo_accession, final_subtype ) |>
    mutate(final_subtype=dplyr::recode(final_subtype, ATLL="ATLL",
    "PTCL-TBX21"="PTCLTBX", "PTCL-GATA3"="PTCLGATA", "ALCL-neg"="ALCLneg", "ALCL-pos"="ALCLpos"))


class(metadata$geo_accession)
```


```{r}
isLog2Transformed <- function(data){
  qx <- as.numeric(quantile(data, c(0., 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99, 1.0), na.rm=T))
  shouldBeLogged <- (qx[5] > 100) || (qx[6]-qx[1] > 50 && qx[2] > 0)
  return(!shouldBeLogged)
  }
isLog2Transformed(exprs(gset))

colnames(gset)

exprs_long <- exprs(gset) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ProbeID") |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ProbeID,
    names_to = "Sample", 
    values_to = "Expression",
    values_drop_na = TRUE  # Drops rows where Expression is NA
  ) |>
  filter(Sample%in%atl_ptcl) 

exprs_long

# Corrected pivot_wider syntax
exprs_wider <- exprs_long |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ProbeID,
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Expression
  )
# Important follow-up steps:
exprs_wider
##  Convert to matrix (for many bioinformatics functions)
exprs_matrix <- exprs_wider |>
  column_to_rownames("ProbeID") |>
  as.matrix()
exprs_matrix

pacman::p_load(tidyplots)

exprs_long |>
    #filter(ProbeID=="ABCC13") |>
    left_join(metadata, by=c("Sample"="geo_accession"))  |>
    tidyplots::tidyplot(x=ProbeID, y=Expression, color=final_subtype) |>
    tidyplots::add_median_dash() |>
    add_test_asterisks() 


unique(exprs_long$ProbeID)

sample_stats <- exprs_long %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_exp = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_exp = median(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_pct = sum(is.na(Expression))/n() * 100
  )
sample_stats

# Density plots by sample
ggplot(exprs_long, aes(Expression, color = Sample)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Expression Distribution by Sample")
```


```{r}
# First perform differential expression analysis to find significant probes
library(limma)

# Create design matrix based on final_subtype
design <- model.matrix(~0 + factor(atl_ptcl$final_subtype))
rownames(design) = atl_ptcl$geo_accession

colnames(design) <- levels(factor(atl_ptcl$final_subtype))
design

all(colnames(exprs_matrix) == rownames(design))
colnames(exprs_matrix)
rownames(exprs_matrix)
# Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(exprs_matrix, design)

# Make contrasts (adjust based on your comparisons)
levels(factor(atl_ptcl$final_subtype))
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  ATLL_vs_PTCLTBX = ATLL - PTCLTBX,
  ATLL_vs_PTCLGATA = ATLL - PTCLGATA,
  ATLL_vs_ENKTL = ATLL - ENKTL,
  ATLL_vs_AITL = ATLL - AITL,
  ATLL_vs_ALCLpos = ATLL - ALCLpos,
  ATLL_vs_ALCLneg = ATLL - ALCLneg,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# Get significant probes (FDR < 0.05)
top_probes <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, p.value = 0.01, adjust.method = "BH")
top_probes |>
    arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
    head(50)

# Filter expression data for significant probes only
exprs_sig <- exprs_long %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c("Sample" = "geo_accession")) %>%
  filter(ProbeID %in% rownames(top_probes)) 

# Create the plot with statistical testing
exprs_sig %>%
  tidyplots::tidyplot(x = ProbeID, y = Expression, color = final_subtype) |>
  tidyplots::add_median_dash() |>
  tidyplots::add_test_asterisks() |>
  tidyplots::adjust_x_title()
```
